terminal_name: Ertugrul Gazi FSRU (open item from country note)
issue: Clears the algeria.md open item ('Ertugrul Gazi FSRU -- loaned to Egypt, or agreement fell through?'). The Ertugrul Gazi is a BOTAS (Turkey)-owned FSRU that operates at Turkey's Dortyol terminal (already in GEM as Dortyol FSRU) and was seasonally chartered to Egypt (Ain Sukhna) for summer 2025. Algeria's ONLY connection is as an LNG supplier: the vessel's first cargo and ongoing volumes come from Sonatrach under the BOTAS-Sonatrach supply deal (~4.4 bcm/yr, extended). It is NOT an Algerian import terminal and never was -- Algeria is a net exporter with no hosted FSRU and no import/regas terminal in any master-plan, DFI pipeline, or sponsor IR. No Algerian FSRU/import gap exists.
suggested_action: Close the algeria.md FSRU open item. No Algerian FSRU terminal to add. The Ertugrul Gazi is correctly a Turkey/Egypt vessel; FSRU-sync (if run) concerns Dortyol/Ain Sukhna, not Algeria.
